guidance_items.text: Use context anchors when they improve precision, especially for ambiguous capitalized text in German legal documents. However, a context anchor is NOT mandatory for every rule.

Person-name patterns must support German characters, including ä, ö, ü, Ä, Ö, Ü, and ß. Do not restrict name components to ASCII-only character classes such as [A-Z][a-z]. Account for umlauts and ß in all relevant parts of names, including hyphenated and multi-part names.

Never fix a broad rule by adding exclusion lists of common nouns (negative lookaheads listing words). If a pattern matches common nouns, require a stronger positive anchor (title, Herr/Frau, role marker, initials) or delete the rule
